description: Assam has launched its first government-owned GPU cluster for AI. This secure infrastructure will power the next generation of public services. The state aims to become an AI-first region, enhancing governance capabilities. Office files and notifications will now be accessible through an AI assistant. This initiative marks a significant first step in Assam's technological advancement.
body_lead: Listen to this article in summarized format Sarma stated in X ,"My vision is to build an AI-First Assam, where Artificial Intelligence becomes a force multiplier for better governance.We have now commissioned our first GPU cluster, creating secure, government-owned AI infrastructure that will power the next generation of public services." Principal secretary (information technology) KS Gopinath Narayan stated in X,"Our first L40S 8-node GPU cluster landed in the state data center hardly two weeks ago.
